children: privately held medical-device company BioCircuit Technologies for $200M in cash, expanding its portfolio of surgical solutions for peripheral nerve repair.
The company anticipates funding the purchase price with the net proceeds from a concurrent public offering of 9.41M shares, priced at $42.50 per share.
The deal is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to customary closing conditions, including the completion of the spin-out of BioCircuit’s electronics R&D business.

BioCircuit has developed NerveTape, the first FDA-approved device designed for sutureless nerve repair.  The deal will strengthen Axogen’s position in the peripheral nerve repair market while adding a differentiated technology to its existing product portfolio.
Axogen expects the acquisition to be accretive to revenue growth, adjusted EBITDA margin, and adjusted earnings per share in the first year following close, while maintaining positive free cash flow.
The firm will provide updated full-year 2026 guidance, including the impact of BioCircuit, following the closing of the transaction.

title: Axogen to buy BioCircuit Technologies for $200M
